# UYWNIX

> UYWNIX is an AI automation company helping businesses automate sales, support, and operations with custom AI agents, chatbots, and workflows.

## What we do
- AI Sales Agents — qualify leads and follow up 24/7
- AI Voice Employees — phone agents that answer and book
- AI Chatbots & Support Agents — instant customer handling
- Workflow Automation — connect CRM, email, WhatsApp into one pipeline
- Custom AI Model Fine-Tuning — train AI on your own data
- Software Development & Prototypes — websites, MVPs, apps

## Products
- UYWNI — all-in-one social platform (feed, encrypted chat, HD video calls, freelance marketplace) with an AI assistant roadmap including real-time multilingual call translation. https://uywni.com
